problem_text:
A logistics company must allocate its fleet of 8 specialized transport vehicles to deliver 8 distinct categories of cargo. The revenue generated per ton for each cargo type is specified below:
* For Cargo Alpha, revenue is 11.209 per ton
* For Cargo Beta, revenue is 12.005 per ton
* For Cargo Gamma, revenue is 19.302 per ton
* For Cargo Delta, revenue is 11.613 per ton
* For Cargo Epsilon, revenue is 5.179 per ton
* For Cargo Zeta, revenue is 13.507 per ton
* For Cargo Eta, revenue is 6.022 per ton
* For Cargo Theta, revenue is 19.88 per ton

The handling duration required per ton for each vehicle is as follows:
*For Cargo Alpha, Vehicle 1 requires 1.387 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 1.494 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 1.448 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 1.894 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 0.929 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 0.702 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 0.342 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 0.241 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Beta, Vehicle 1 requires 1.059 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 1.539 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 1.531 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 0.205 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 1.31 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 1.697 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 1.761 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 1.585 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Gamma, Vehicle 1 requires 0.954 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 1.467 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 1.463 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 0.316 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 0.27 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 0.823 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 1.358 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 0.886 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Delta, Vehicle 1 requires 1.361 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 1.571 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 1.588 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 0.71 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 1.949 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 1.197 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 1.33 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 1.343 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Epsilon, Vehicle 1 requires 1.412 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 0.477 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 1.414 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 0.977 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 1.944 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 1.485 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 1.953 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 1.984 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Zeta, Vehicle 1 requires 1.701 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 1.255 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 1.281 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 1.045 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 0.865 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 0.954 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 1.844 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 1.363 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Eta, Vehicle 1 requires 0.506 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 0.267 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 0.99 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 0.994 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 0.318 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 0.608 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 0.797 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 0.878 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Theta, Vehicle 1 requires 1.325 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 requires 0.481 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 requires 1.679 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 requires 1.095 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 requires 0.324 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 requires 0.379 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 requires 1.898 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 requires 0.258 (ton-hours)

* Vehicle 1's total available handling time is capped at 261.971 hours.
* Vehicle 2's total available handling time is capped at 180.162 hours.
* Vehicle 3's total available handling time is capped at 267.713 hours.
* Vehicle 4's total available handling time is capped at 151.754 hours.
* Vehicle 5's total available handling time is capped at 162.306 hours.
* Vehicle 6's total available handling time is capped at 163.582 hours.
* Vehicle 7's total available handling time is capped at 310.28 hours.
* Vehicle 8's total available handling time is capped at 194.245 hours.

Under the condition that for each vehicle, the cumulative handling duration for all cargo assigned must not surpass its operational time limit, determine the optimal tonnage allocation for each cargo category to maximize the aggregate revenue.
